plants.sentence: The size of the residuals is a reliable guide to the size of true forecast errors, so a model's accuracy can be judged on the same data used to fit it.
Picking the model with the smallest RMSE under time series cross-validation always finds the model that will forecast best, guaranteed.
The damping parameter is usually kept between 0.5 and 0.7: above 0.7 the damping is very strong, and close to 0 a damped model cannot be told apart from an undamped one.
The drift method lets naive forecasts rise or fall over time by the average change seen in the historical data; Box and Jenkins first proposed it in 1970.
When two series trend upwards in the same way, such as air passengers in Australia and rice production in Guinea, one of them is driving the other.
